premise: After nursing my husband through his final illness, I inherited his 1957 Chevy Bel Air appraised at $125,000 and partnered with my sister-in-law to open a classic-car detailing shop, using the car as collateral for a $70,000 SBA loan, but she forged a title transfer, sold the Bel Air for $95,000, and disappeared; I traced the VIN, repossessed the car at an out-of-state auction, and now run ‘Spit Shine & Subpoenas’ mobile detailing—every service invoice includes her outstanding arrest warrant number and a 10% discount for law enforcement.
